body.intent: Fix False hand-commit intervention: run 01M7RHR8NEJTECVZ5FYFDJ0H18 (change set 01M7RHC6VMMBXVWS3BKKFF6F8N) journals 'Interventions: 1 (hand-commit 1)' for commit 351cf62f6 'Land and render the run-status flake fix', which its own conductor (session 9239a99d, actor claude-code-9239a99d) made after rhiza land and rhiza render. The commit has no Change:/Actor:/Leaf:/Review: trailer, so handCommits (internal/api/run_handcommit.go) counts it as a hand commit and the daemon's clean streak breaks with no human involved. Earlier conductors happened to add trailers; nothing makes them. Make the conductor's own land/render commit always recognised (e.g. rhiza land/render commit with the run's trailers, or the conduct guide and a check requiring Change: and Actor: trailers on every conductor commit), and add a test where a conductor's land commit is not journalled as an intervention. This blocks milestone 40's measure (10 consecutive clean runs).
